mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 50 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the Public Works Department reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles all weekly refuse and biweekly recycling pickups. Also, please note that the Verona Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday.

There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, along with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join trivia nights at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's starting this Tuesday.

Looking at the weekly report, on October 25, officers responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at an intersection for 20 minutes, which resulted in the arrest of a 40-year-old man for his first O W I offence.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy a scoop of Mint Explosion at Culver's. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by and enjoy the flavor of the day.
